channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Andrew Wiggins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Andrew Wiggins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Andrew Wiggins, Davion Mitchell, Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Giannis Antetokounmpo on being in Miami:

“Coach Spo brings the best out of players. I want to be coached hard…. I want people when they’re at work thinking about the Heat. I want people when they’re at their couch watching their favorite show to turn that off and put the Heat…I’m very excited to get in the gym with Bam, Mitchell, Wiggins, all these great players, Jovic.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Andrew Wiggins, Davion Mitchell, Nikola Jovic, Jul 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Andrew Wiggins' hip injury:

“It just got really tight the latter part of the fourth quarter. He's day-to-day. He also wasn't feeling well that whole game. So that might have had an effect a little bit. But overall we're encouraged by the prognosis on it.”

Erik Spoelstra on Andrew Wiggins, Nov 21, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on not playing Andrew Wiggins in the fourth quarter tonight:

“I actually put him at the scorer’s table at six to go and the group wanted to keep on pushing through. We stayed with it. But, obviously, he’ll be very important the rest of the series.”

Erik Spoelstra on Andrew Wiggins, Apr 24, 2025. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
“This is the first situation that’s it has really been just me and Tyler. I mean, obviously, the addition of [Andrew Wiggins], but we’re still trying to get Wiggs comfortable to where he can be fully himself. Right now, we’re keeping it simple for him and just kind of getting out of his way. But for me and Tyler, it’s more so understanding that we know how hard it is to win in this league. You can never take that for granted.”

Bam Adebayo on Andrew Wiggins, Mar 15, 2025. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Adebayo said about Wiggins.

“We know what type of talent is. I mean, watching him in ones right now, it's like, he's got game. He's got all the tools to be a successfulplayer. I feel like once he really gets comfortable here, he'll get back to the All Star Andrew.”

Bam Adebayo on Andrew Wiggins, Mar 11, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Pat Riley on Andrew Wiggins, Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Pat Riley on Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell and Andrew Wiggins:

“They are now officially part of what we do believe in, which is our culture here with the Heat. And we believe they are perfect players to be part of that. I think they’ll show it.”

Pat Riley on Andrew Wiggins, Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell, Feb 9, 2025. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins:

“Just had a baby boy last week. Girls in school. Wiggs is one of my favorite players I’ve ever coached. Just a wonderful soul. We don’t hang that banner in ‘22 without him…I’m gonna miss him.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, Feb 6, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
“Wiggins went right at him, and that’s a great learning experience for him because what you’re seeing now in the NBA a lot is they’re taking starters and staggering them and putting them in second units, and it’s going to be matchups that he’s got to learn and grow from.“Even though that was a two- or three-minute stint, I think that’s valuable for him. He’s got to understand it can’t be OK.”

Billy Donovan on Andrew Wiggins, Jan 26, 2025. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins:

“He looks physically really fit. Speaking with him, he sounds very motivated…He knows the last couple years have been tough for a lot of reasons. I think he’s primed to get back to where he was a couple years ago.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, Sep 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
“His normal time to go back in would have been around the five-, six-minute mark (of the fourth). (Andrew Wiggins) was playing great, we were rolling, were up 18, 19, whatever it was. So we just stayed with him. Then at that (later) point, it didn’t feel like the right thing to do. He had been sitting for a while. So I stayed with the group that was out there and obviously we couldn’t close it out.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, Jan 5, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
TheWarriorsTalk:Kerr on Wiggins' slow start to the season:

“I'm not worried abt Wiggs at all. It's a slow start, and he's got a long track record, he's been with us for 5 yrs now so he knows how we play. I can probably try to help him out a little bit with some things but Wiggs will get there.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, Nov 6, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Chris Paul on Draymond Green, Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
“I'm excited about Steph, Draymond, Klay, all the different guys, Wigs [Andrew Wiggins],”

Chris Paul on Draymond Green, Andrew Wiggins, Aug 16, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
“We’re just taking things as they come. I know we’ve all talked publicly about we’re giving Andrew the space he needs to deal with something that’s incredibly serious and difficult. And that’s really the only thing that matters. The door’s open for him if and when he’s ready. And if not, that’s fine, too. In the end, we all love Andrew and we’re concerned about his well-being more than anything. So we’re supporting him.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, Mar 31, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steph Curry on Andrew Wiggins:

“We’d love to have him and hope that that does happen…But when he walks through the door is when it’ll be the right time.”

Stephen Curry on Andrew Wiggins, Mar 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
“The fact that a rumor about Andrew Wiggins — I don’t know if it’s true. I’m not here to confirm whether it’s true or not. I really don’t care, like it ain’t got nothing to do with me. You hear stuff like that and you care for like him and her, like and their children. So I care from that perspective. But whether what y’all said is true or not really has no bearing on my life nor does it have any bearing on your life.”

Draymond Green on Andrew Wiggins, Mar 25, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Draymond Green, Andrew Wiggins, Andrew Poole
item.description:
Steph Curry on the contract extension eligibility of Draymond, Poole, Wiggins, Klay:

“We want the best chance to win every single year. We’ve proven with this squad what the results have been. We want to keep it together as long as we can.”

Stephen Curry on Draymond Green, Andrew Wiggins, Andrew Poole, Sep 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
“Like an Andrew Wiggins. I think he was the one who beat us, and I told him that after the series. We knew what to expect from Klay and from Steph and from Draymond. We didn’t know what to expect or how Wiggs would step up, and he did.”

Mark Cuban on Andrew Wiggins, Aug 16, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jimmy Butler, Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Draymond Green on Andrew Wiggins:

“When he first came, I'll never forget Thibs, when wasn't with the Knicks, he was like, 'You're going to love him. He competes. He defends. Jimmy loved him.' We all know how Jimmy Butler is. If you have any softness to you, Jimmy don't like you.”

Draymond Green on Jimmy Butler, Andrew Wiggins, Jun 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Steve Kerr today on the reconstruction of the Warriors:

“I think the (Andrew) Wiggins trade is the key to all of this.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, May 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins:

“I expect him to play (in Game 3). Technically he's questionable, but I expect him to play.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, May 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Mike Brown on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Brown on Wiggins’ engaged defense:

“He was just engaged from jump street. This morning during shootaround, I knew he would have a big game because we changed our pick and roll coverage, and when we made the change, Wiggs asked, he was like, ‘You want me to pick up Ty Jones full court?’ I said, ‘Wiggs, you want to do that for 48 minutes?’ He said, ‘I’m locked in. I’ll do it for 48 minutes. You just tell me.’ I said, ‘Okay. Well, pick and choose your spots.’ When a guy like that comes to you and says that, you know he’s ready for the task at hand.”

Mike Brown on Andrew Wiggins, May 14, 2022. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins after he shot 5-of-19 against Orlando:

“I have faith in Wigs. I think he's going to get this thing turned around and have a strong final 10 games. I really do.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, Mar 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Klay Thompson on Andrew Wiggins:

“He will be an All-Star multiple times. This is just the beginning, I feel.”

Klay Thompson on Andrew Wiggins, Jan 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins' All-Star candidacy:

“I really, really hope he makes it. I think he deserves it.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, Jan 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Draymond Green, Andrew Wiggins, James Wiseman, Jordan Poole, Jonathan Kuminga, Moses Moody
item.description:
“We had a great last decade and our goal is to set ourselves up for another great decade. We’ve got Steph, Klay and Draymond for the next several years at a high level, hopefully longer. [Andrew] Wiggins is only 26. With [Jordan] Poole, [James] Wiseman, [Jonathan] Kuminga and [Moses] Moody, we’ve got a lot of talent to develop and a lot of work to do, but we’re pretty excited.”

Joe Lacob on Draymond Green, Andrew Wiggins, James Wiseman, Jordan Poole, Jonathan Kuminga, Moses Moody, Jan 10, 2022. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Jimmy Butler, Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Andre Iguodala on Andrew Wiggins:

“We had a common teammate — Jimmy Butler. Jimmy had nothing but positive things to say about Wiggs. That was all I needed to hear.”

Andre Iguodala on Jimmy Butler, Andrew Wiggins, Dec 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins:

“We're not counting on him to score 25 points a night. ... We've very comfortable with Wiggs just playing basketball.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, Oct 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
Kerr:

“Andrew got vaccinated. He just told me today that he was fine with us acknowledging it and that will be the end of it. I’m not going to answer any questions beyond that.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Wiggins, Oct 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @NickFriedell.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
“I’ve been upset reading about Andrew Wiggins because it’s painting the wrong picture,”

Andre Iguodala on Andrew Wiggins, Oct 2, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andrew Wiggins
item.description:
95.7 The Game: Draymond Green on Andrew Wiggins/COVID-19 vaccine:

“It’s not my place to tell him what he should or shouldn’t do... That’s his personal choice.”

Draymond Green on Andrew Wiggins, Oct 1, 2021. Source: Twitter.
